description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the SubjectsModifiedStrategy in handling SubjectsModified events, particularly focusing on the creation of a new Label entry with associated subjects within a policy object.

classes.name: SubjectsModifiedStrategyCreateTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the SubjectsModifiedStrategy's handling of SubjectsModified events, ensuring new Labels are created correctly with the associated subjects and empty resources.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Returns an instance of SubjectsModifiedStrategy to be tested.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Creates and returns a SubjectsModified event with specified instant and policy, for testing.

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Performs assertions on the policy after the event has been applied, verifying that the new label was created with correct subjects and resources, and existing labels are untouched.
